description:
Tired of default app settings? In this video, we show you how to fully customize the GitHub Copilot app to match your personal workflow. Learn how to change themes and notification sounds, configure voice dictation models, and plug in custom MCP servers or local AI models via bring your own key. We also explore advanced features like custom automations and interactive canvases for orchestrating agentic sessions.

Download GitHub Copilot app today: https://gh.io/app
